launch_plan.test: Day-1 YouTube Test & Compare, A/B/C; future authorised publishing job only
launch_plan.decision: Chief selects title and reviews all three finished images; leave test until YouTube names a winner. Log makers, CTR/impressions when available and watch-time shares in the thumbnail ledger.
launch_plan.shared_design: One large focal point, scale or consequence visible at 168×94. House heavy sans, one yellow hook word, other words white, outline, clear top or edge band, no Orbit, no small text. Grade and phone-preview gates apply; C tests a bright high-contrast background.

concepts.picture: One large suited explorer stands beside a dark methane lake under amber haze. The human is the focal point; a low water-ice bank and lake horizon give scale. Keep the suit visibly closed and insulated; no bare skin or suggestion of breathable air.
concepts.source_image: Original illustrative scene to be built separately; real Huygens surface imagery for colour and terrain, Cassini Kraken Mare observations for shoreline reference. No claim that a person has visited Titan.

concepts.picture: A large Huygens probe rests among rounded water-ice pebbles on a dry riverbed. The probe dominates, with a single foreground pebble giving scale. This is a new lander-centred view, distinct from the explorer-and-lake concept.
concepts.source_image: ESA/NASA Huygens surface photograph as terrain reference and ESA Huygens hardware imagery as probe reference. Any reconstructed view must be identified as an illustration; verify per-image credits.

concepts.picture: One large eight-rotor Dragonfly craft banks over a pale dune ridge. Use a bright gold-to-cream sky and deep teal shadows for the high-contrast background test. The ridge gives scale; the flying craft is the sole focal point.
concepts.source_image: NASA/Johns Hopkins APL Dragonfly spacecraft illustration as hardware reference, Huygens terrain imagery for colour reference. This is a mission concept, not footage of a flight on Titan.
